user_query: I want to surprise my family with customized shoes as gifts. Can you help me find a specific item from the collection of shoes? Additionally, I need to check the availability of coupon codes for the selected shoes to get a discount. Also, I want to know the average price of a MacBook Pro 13" 2020 model to decide if it fits my budget.

TaskList.description: Search for a specific item in the collection of customized shoes.
Check the availability of coupon codes for the selected shoes.
Retrieve the average price for a MacBook Pro 13" 2020 model.
